mentions.name: Spell Forge
mentions.description: This app creates and prints spell cards for Dungeons & Dragons, so players can be handed a printed card for their spells during in-person sessions.
mentions.problem: The group's players are quite new to the game, so printed reference cards help them with their spells.
mentions.audience: The author's in-person Dungeons & Dragons group, including players who are quite new to the game
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I build these two app to create items and spell cards and print them out.

https://www.item-forge.org/

https://www.spell-forge.org/
